subtitle: A place to share, be heard, and find the support you need.
feeling: How have you been feeling recently?
fear: How often have you felt anxious or afraid?
avoidance: Have you avoided people or places because of fear?
legal: Have legal proceedings increased your stress?
threat: Are you facing threats or intimidation?
safe: Do you feel safe at present?
support: Do you have someone you can rely on?
text: Would you like to tell us anything in your own words?
consentText: We collect your check-in responses to help your authorized support team understand changes in wellbeing. AI may identify distress indicators; people review recommendations and decide on support. This is not a diagnosis. Voice is optional; recordings are processed into supporting acoustic features and are not retained. Browser transcription may use your browser provider’s service. You can withdraw optional collection here at any time. Withdrawal stops new collection; previously submitted records remain in the prototype database for follow-up and audit.
agree: I agree to optional wellbeing analysis
voiceAgree: I also agree to optional voice processing
thanksText: Your concern is recorded. Your authorized support team can review it and arrange support.
voiceNote: Optional: record up to 90 seconds. Review or type the transcript below before submitting.
